title: On the Birch-Swinnerton-Dyer quotients modulo squares
version: arXiv:math/0610290v3, October 20, 2008. Later published in Annals of Mathematics 172 no.1 (2010), 567-596, DOI 10.4007/annals.2010.172.567; retained locators refer to the arXiv v3.

used_locators.scope: The p-infinity Selmer rank parity theorem for every elliptic curve over Q and every prime p; the theorem is unconditional, unlike the separate preceding theorem on algebraic rank.
p-infinity Selmer rank equals the Mordell-Weil rank plus the number of Qp/Zp copies in Sha.
Same all-prime parity theorem, with its proof. No finiteness of Sha is assumed.

role: Primary external all-prime Selmer-parity theorem; proof imported, not replayed.
